note: One playthrough is enough: no difficulty settings, no online trophies, no New Game+. Free-roam continues after the story.

bullets: Play the 5 chapters in order — the story takes roughly 60–80 hours.
Take the optional missions and stranger strands as they appear; some expire (the hourglass icons). Quest givers can go quiet for a while, but every trophy-related one comes back.
Scan vehicles with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars as you travel — 200 vehicles and 100 animals count toward 100%.
Turn on every progress and collectible notification in the settings, so nothing passes unnoticed.
stages.missable_callout: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends (see Positive Mental Attitude) — it is the only trophy that may be missable.
stages.summary: Finish the story and do the optional content as it shows up.
stages.title: Play the story

bullets: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion — the checklist only appears after the story, but progress made during the story already counts.
Every robbery: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs and 8 bank vault robberies.
70 of the 80 challenges (you can skip the 10 hardest).
All underwater discoveries (33), Shooting Range golds (42 challenges), drone-race wins (14 locations) and Bret's quests and Target Decks.
Collectibles: 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied.
stages.summary: Work the 100% checklist — the longest stretch, and the hardest trophy in the set.
stages.title: Reach 100% completion

bullets: Finish any remaining stranger strands — 8 in total for the silver.
Complete the character quest finals (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) if any are left.
Mop up the miscellaneous trophies: partner, robbery, secret and activity trophies.
Check the tracker in this guide for anything still unticked — then the platinum pops.
stages.summary: Strangers & Freaks and whatever is still missing.
stages.title: Clean up and platinum

title: Platinum roadmap

warnings.text: Only one trophy may be missable: Positive Mental Attitude — the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia. Everything else can be done after the story in free-roam.
warnings.title: Missable: 1 (possibly)

warnings.text: There is no mission replay. Save manually at the start and end of every chapter.
warnings.title: No mission replay

warnings.text: Guides report that cheats disable trophies and saving. Keep them off for the whole trophy run.
warnings.title: Cheats off

warnings.text: The Irredeemable criminal profile cannot be undone. Andy's quests are Lucia-only; Tyrone's and Bret's are Jason-only.
warnings.title: Watch out
